New or Featured Training Courses Providing Follow-up Support to Laboratory Learners Strengthen knowledge, skills, and abilities (KSAs) by reinforcing the training content with follow-up support. Microbiology Curriculum: Basic Culture Media and Isolation Techniques This course introduces basic culture media and microbiological techniques, including four-quadrant streaking and troubleshooting common culture issues. Ready? Set? Test! Patient Testing Is Important. Get the Right Results. The basics of training for safely and accurately performing patient testing waived under CLIA. We Are OneLab Newsletter June 2023 September 2023 April 2024 Recently Added Job Aids Microbiology Curriculum: Basic Culture Media and Isolation Techniques – 4 Quadrant Streak Video Job Aid Key Questions for Planning Follow-up Support Printable Job Aid Follow-Up Support Action Plan Printable Job Aid Providing Follow-up Support to Laboratory Learners Printable Job Aid Assessing Laboratory Learner Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Printable Job Aid Improving Laboratory Training Through Evaluation Printable Job Aid OneLab REACH is a customized learning management system designed specifically for laboratory professionals and the testing community. It’s a one-stop shop for all of your learning laboratory training needs. OneLab Network is a collaborative network that provides access to customized laboratory education and training resources. It connects laboratory professionals and CDC through free live events. OneLab TEST aims to connect and train a community of practice among professionals and volunteers who perform or coordinate testing at non-laboratory sites. OneLab VR is a multiplayer virtual reality (VR) environment that allows learners to take on-demand VR trainings and trainers to use the space to deliver live trainings to students. OneLab Summit is a free, three-day virtual meeting that connects laboratory professionals in real time to support a unified response to laboratory training needs. OneLab Resources include free eLearning trainings, video and printable job aids, and toolkits for laboratory professionals and the testing community. OneLab Assessment helps OneLab™ develop and promote new public health laboratory training resources.
